GS.rationale: Goldman Sachs delivered a blowout Q1 2026 with record-equivalent earnings (EPS $17.55, second-highest ever), 19.8% ROE, and record Global Banking & Markets revenue of $12.7B driven by advisory (+89% YoY) and record equities ($5.3B). The firm is the #1 global M&A advisor with 32% market share, and AUS hit a record $3.65T. However, the stock has already re-rated significantly: P/E has expanded from ~13x a year ago to 16.5x now, and P/B from 1.6x to 2.4x, pricing in much of the improvement. Operating cash flow was deeply negative at -$31.9B in Q1 (typical for GS given balance-sheet dynamics but still a risk flag). The macro backdrop is mixed — elevated oil prices and rising long-term yields create headwinds for deal activity, though the VIX has normalized. No clear near-term fundamental catalyst beyond the strong Q1 print that is already reflected in the price. The score reflects strong fundamentals and trajectory offset by a valuation that has already moved to the upper end of its 1-year range.
